name: Ace of Pentacles
title: Ace of Disks
imagery: A great golden disk spins with wings, decorated with intricate symbols at its center. It is the seed of the material world.
meaning: The Ace of Disks is the root of Earth: material foundation, health and manifestation. A solid beginning is offered.
numerology: The Ace is the seed of the element.

ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be fear of lack.

name: Two of Pentacles
title: Two of Disks: Change
imagery: Two disks bearing yin-yang symbols are encircled by a serpent forming a figure eight, symbolizing endless change.
meaning: Change is the constant flow of life. Adapt and find balance in motion.

name: Three of Pentacles
title: Three of Disks: Works
imagery: Three wheels sit at the base of a pyramid seen from above, set in a sea of gray-blue.
meaning: Works is constructive effort. Building something solid through collaboration and hard work.

name: Four of Pentacles
title: Four of Disks: Power
imagery: Four square disks form the towers of a fortress, viewed from above, surrounded by a moat.
meaning: Power is material stability and control. Your position is secure.

name: Five of Pentacles
title: Five of Disks: Worry
imagery: Five disks form an inverted pentagram, like gears grinding together under strain.
meaning: Worry is material anxiety. Stress about money or health weighs on you. Take practical steps.

ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be fear of loss.

name: Six of Pentacles
title: Six of Disks: Success
imagery: Six planetary disks surround a central glowing rose cross in a balanced, radiant hexagram.
meaning: Success is material harmony and achievement. Your efforts are rewarded.

ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be fear of losing it.

name: Seven of Pentacles
title: Seven of Disks: Failure
imagery: Seven dull, lead-colored disks are set against withered vegetation, as if the harvest has been blighted.
meaning: Failure is effort that does not bear fruit. Reassess and try a new approach.

ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be fear of failure.

name: Eight of Pentacles
title: Eight of Disks: Prudence
imagery: Eight disks hang like fruit from a carefully tended tree, ripening slowly.
meaning: Prudence is careful, steady work. Tend your projects patiently and they will grow.
affirmation: I tend my work with care.

ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be fear of risk.

name: Nine of Pentacles
title: Nine of Disks: Gain
imagery: Nine disks are arranged in a harmonious pattern of circles, glowing with prosperity.
meaning: Gain is material increase and good fortune. Wealth grows.

name: Ten of Pentacles
title: Ten of Disks: Wealth
imagery: Ten coins bearing symbols are arranged in the Tree of Life pattern, glowing with golden light.
meaning: Wealth is material completion. Lasting abundance and legacy are yours. Use it wisely.

ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be fear of loss.

name: Page of Pentacles
title: Princess of Disks
imagery: A princess wearing a ram-horned headdress stands in a grove holding a large disk with a rose at its center. She appears to be pregnant with new life.
meaning: The Princess of Disks is the fertile potential of Earth. New growth and possibility are carried within.
numerology: The Princess is the element made manifest.

ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be fear of change.

name: Knight of Pentacles
title: Prince of Disks
imagery: A prince rides a chariot pulled by a bull through fields of grain, holding a globe.
meaning: The Prince of Disks is practical and diligent. He manifests through steady, reliable work.
numerology: The Prince is the element in motion.
affirmation: I work steadily toward my goals.

name: Queen of Pentacles
title: Queen of Disks
imagery: A queen sits on a pineapple throne in a desert turning green, holding an orb and a scepter. A goat stands nearby on a globe.
meaning: The Queen of Disks is patient and nurturing. She transforms the barren into the fruitful.
numerology: The Queen is the receptive power.

name: King of Pentacles
title: Knight of Disks
imagery: An armored knight rides a heavy horse through fields of ripe grain, carrying a flail and a great disk shield.
meaning: The Thoth Knight of Disks is the active force of Earth. He brings patient labor and a rich harvest.
numerology: The Knight is the element at its most active.
affirmation: I reap the harvest of my work.
